Alvaro Montero.note: Montero stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Alvaro Montero.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Andres Gomez.note: Gómez's signature is explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Andres Gomez.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在看到空当后的爆发速度上。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Camilo Vargas.note: Vargas is defined by staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Camilo Vargas.noteZh: 他靠在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Cucho Hernandez.note: Watch Hernández for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Cucho Hernandez.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Daniel Munoz.note: Muñoz's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Daniel Munoz.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

David Ospina.note: Ospina stands out for staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
David Ospina.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Davinson Sanchez.note: Sánchez is defined by recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Davinson Sanchez.noteZh: 他靠防线暴露后的回追速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Deiver Machado.note: Machado is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Deiver Machado.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Gustavo Puerta.note: Puerta is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Gustavo Puerta.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

James Rodriguez.note: Rodríguez's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
James Rodriguez.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球上。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Jaminton Campaz.note: Campaz's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Jaminton Campaz.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Jefferson Lerma.note: Lerma's edge is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Jefferson Lerma.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Jhon Arias.note: Arias's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Jhon Arias.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Jhon Cordoba.note: Córdoba is defined by making the next teammate's action easier. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Jhon Cordoba.noteZh: 他靠让队友下一步处理更轻松与同位置球员拉开差异。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Jhon Lucumi.note: Watch Lucumí for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Jhon Lucumi.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Johan Mojica.note: Watch Mojica for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Johan Mojica.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是防线暴露后的回追速度。留意他如何传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Jorge Carrascal.note: Carrascal stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Jorge Carrascal.noteZh: 他的突出特点是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Juan Portilla.note: Portilla stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Juan Portilla.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Juan Quintero.note: Quintero's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Juan Quintero.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Kevin Castano.note: Castaño's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Kevin Castano.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Luis Diaz.note: Díaz is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Luis Diaz.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Luis Suarez.note: Suárez stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Luis Suarez.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Richard Rios.note: Watch Ríos for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Richard Rios.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。留意他如何承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Santiago Arias.note: Arias's edge is calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Santiago Arias.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Willer Ditta.note: Ditta is defined by using strength without slowing the next action. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Willer Ditta.noteZh: 他靠在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Yerry Mina.note: Mina is defined by reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Yerry Mina.noteZh: 他靠在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹与同位置球员拉开差异。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。
